data.limitation: Public Binance spot klines. The forming candle is dropped. Gaps are left empty. api.binance.com may return HTTP 451 in some regions; the loader then uses data-api.binance.vision and does not invent bars. This is not a full tick history, so fills are bar-open approximations.

disclaimer: Historical backtest only. This is not paper-trading performance and not live performance. It is not a recommendation to trade. Costs, fills and the strategy list are assumptions.

gates.description: A candidate passes only if all of the following are true on the primary cost model: at least 5 walk-forward test folds; at least 60% of those folds have a positive net return; the Newey-West 95% interval for the mean out-of-sample bar return lies entirely above zero; the skeptical Bayesian probability that the out-of-sample mean is positive is at least 0.95; the out-of-sample HAC p-value survives a Bonferroni correction across the 9-candidate family; and the single final 30% holdout also has a positive total return whose HAC 95% interval lies above zero. Buy-and-hold is the benchmark and is not in the family. Failing the gate does not prove that no edge exists.

verdict.detail: None of the pre-registered candidates cleared the walk-forward, holdout, cost, Bayesian and multiple-testing bar. Buy-and-hold can still be up. That is exposure to BTC, not evidence that a timing rule has an edge. The evidence is insufficient to establish a trading edge.
verdict.headline: No candidate showed a reliable out-of-sample edge after costs.
